layout.body:
Website: https://www.fitlifegym.com
FitLife Gym Membership
Monthly plan: $30, equipment access only.
Quarterly plan: $80, includes group classes and swimming pool privileges.
Annual plan: $300, includes personal training discounts plus guest passes.
New member offer: One-week free trial, with a commitment to a minimum three-month membership afterward.

questions.stem: What benefits does a quarterly member have that a monthly member lacks?
questions.analysis: What benefits does a quarterly member have that a monthly member lacks? 原文依据： Monthly plan: $30, equipment access only. Quarterly plan: $80, includes group classes and swimming pool privileges. 翻译： 月卡：30 美元，仅可使用健身器材。季卡：80 美元，包含团体课程和泳池使用权。 选项分析： (A) Equipment access and guest passes 健身器材使用权和访客券 → 错误 (B) Personal training discounts only 仅私教折扣 → 错误 (C) Group classes and swimming privileges 团体课程和泳池使用权 → 正确 (D) Free trial and minimum commitment 免费试用和最低会员期限 → 错误

questions.stem: What is required of new members after the one-week free trial ends?
questions.analysis: What is required of new members after the one-week free trial ends? 原文依据： New member offer: One-week free trial, with a commitment to a minimum three-month membership afterward. 翻译： 新会员优惠：一周免费试用，之后需承诺至少办理三个月会员。 选项分析： (A) Nothing 无要求 → 错误 (B) A one-month membership 一个月会员 → 错误 (C) A three-month membership 三个月会员 → 正确 (D) An annual membership 一年会员 → 错误
